title: HEC Pakistan Plagiarism Policy & Thresholds Explained

content.quick: The Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan mandates an overall Turnitin similarity index of at most 19% for MS, MPhil, and PhD theses, with no single source exceeding 5%. Permitted exclusions include properly cited quotes, references, small matches (5-7 words), and preliminary administrative pages.

sentences.text: The Higher Education Commission of Pakistan revised its statutory plagiarism policy in 2020 to establish clear national thresholds for postgraduate research degrees.
sentences.simple: In 2020, the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan set strict official rules for how much copied text is allowed in university theses.
sentences.plain: The Higher Education Commission of Pakistan revised its statutory plagiarism policy in 2020 to establish clear national thresholds for postgraduate research degrees.
sentences.technical: Pursuant to statutory regulatory authority, the Higher Education Commission of Pakistan promulgated the Revised Plagiarism Policy (2020), codifying uniform psychometric similarity thresholds across postgraduate curricula.

sentences.text: Under the revised policy, the maximum permissible overall similarity index for an MS, MPhil, or PhD thesis is nineteen percent.
sentences.simple: The highest allowed total similarity score on Turnitin for your Master's or PhD thesis is 19%.
sentences.plain: Under the revised policy, the maximum permissible overall similarity index for an MS, MPhil, or PhD thesis is nineteen percent.
sentences.technical: Statutory institutional regulations dictate an upper empirical ceiling of nineteen percent (19%) for cumulative textual similarity on automated comparative corpora.

visual.title: HEC Thesis Similarity Index Scale
visual.caption: Aim for a final similarity index between 8% and 14% to ensure effortless departmental clearance.

sentences.text: A similarity index below nineteen percent does not guarantee clearance if a single source contributes an excessive percentage of overlapping text.
sentences.simple: Even if your total score is only 10%, you can still fail if you copied too much text from just one single article.
sentences.plain: A similarity index below nineteen percent does not guarantee clearance if a single source contributes an excessive percentage of overlapping text.
sentences.technical: Sub-threshold cumulative similarity (< 19%) does not constitute algorithmic immunity if monographic source concentrations violate individual ceiling parameters.

sentences.text: The policy strictly caps any single source match at five percent, meaning no single publication may account for more than five percent of your total thesis text.
sentences.simple: You can never have more than 5% similarity coming from any single website, book, or research article.
sentences.plain: The policy strictly caps any single source match at five percent, meaning no single publication may account for more than five percent of your total thesis text.
sentences.technical: The regulatory framework enforces an individual source boundary condition of five percent (5%), precluding localized textual expropriation regardless of aggregate metrics.

blocks.explain: Many students in Pakistan think: 'My Turnitin score is 12%, so I am completely safe!' But if 7% came from one journal article, your thesis will be rejected. You must meet two rules at the same time: total under 19%, AND no single source above 5%.

questions.q: A student receives a Turnitin similarity report showing an overall index of 14%, but Source #1 contributes 7% of the total match. What is the status of this thesis under HEC policy?
options: Approved — the overall score is well beneath the 19% ceiling.
Rejected for defense — the single source exceeds the mandatory 5% individual limit.
Approved — single source limits only apply to PhD dissertations, not MS theses.
Requires supervisor fee payment before clearance.
questions.hint: Check both the overall index and the individual source ceiling.
questions.explanation: Option 2 is correct. Under HEC policy, a thesis is non-compliant if ANY single source exceeds 5%, even if the total score is under 19%. The student must rewrite and re-screen the section matching Source #1.

sentences.text: To prevent false-positive mechanical matches, HEC policy permits specific standardized filters when generating similarity reports.
sentences.simple: To stop Turnitin from marking innocent sentences as copied, the university turns on official filters during scanning.
sentences.plain: To prevent false-positive mechanical matches, HEC policy permits specific standardized filters when generating similarity reports.
sentences.technical: To mitigate algorithmic false-positive inflation attributable to invariant syntactic structures, the regulatory protocol permits standardized programmatic exclusion parameters.

items.label: Exclude Bibliography / References

visual.caption: Applying these exact settings ensures fair and standardized evaluation across universities.

sentences.text: The reference list or terminal bibliography must be excluded from the similarity calculation because standard citations create massive artificial overlap.
sentences.simple: Your bibliography at the end of the thesis must be turned off in Turnitin, because book and journal titles match everyone else's work.
sentences.plain: The reference list or terminal bibliography must be excluded from the similarity calculation because standard citations create massive artificial overlap.
sentences.technical: Bibliographic references must be algorithmically excluded; standardized bibliographic entries produce artificial collinear matches against global repository databases.

visual.title: Turnitin Score Impact: Bibliography Included vs Excluded
visual.caption: Always ensure your university focal person selects 'Exclude Bibliography'.

sentences.text: Legitimate direct quotations properly enclosed in quotation marks with accurate citations may also be excluded from the score.
sentences.simple: Properly credited quotes in quotation marks can be excluded so they don't count against your 19% limit.
sentences.plain: Legitimate direct quotations properly enclosed in quotation marks with accurate citations may also be excluded from the score.
sentences.technical: Verbatim quotes demarcated by typographical quotes and accompanied by formal attribution are excluded from similarity computations.

visual.title: Quotation Exclusion Requirements

dos: Use standard double quotation marks ("...") around short quotes
Include author, year, and page number immediately adjacent to the quote
Verify that your university Turnitin filter has 'Exclude Quotes' turned on
donts: Put quotes around entire pages of your literature review
Use single quotes or unclosed quotation marks that Turnitin ignores
Quote without providing an author citation

visual.caption: Turnitin will only exclude quotes if the quotation marks and citation are properly structured.

sentences.text: Finally, small phrase matches of five to seven words are filtered out to prevent common academic phrases like 'independent samples t-test' from being penalized.
sentences.simple: Short common phrases of 5 to 7 words are ignored so you don't get penalized for writing normal research words.
sentences.plain: Finally, small phrase matches of five to seven words are filtered out to prevent common academic phrases like 'independent samples t-test' from being penalized.
sentences.technical: A phrase match filter of 5 to 7 words is applied to screen idiomatic disciplinary boilerplate and methodological nomenclature from algorithmic scoring.

blocks.explain: If your university Turnitin scanner leaves the bibliography turned on, your score will jump by 10% to 15% simply because thousands of other students cited the same books! Always ask your QEC (Quality Enhancement Cell) officer to verify that the bibliography and quote filters are active.

questions.q: Which of the following items are legitimately permitted to be excluded during official HEC Turnitin similarity screening?
options: Direct quotations with accurate author citations.
Any paragraph with more than 30% similarity.
Common methodological phrases filtered via a 5-7 word small match filter.
questions.hint: Select all standardized exclusion parameters approved by HEC policy.
questions.explanation: The terminal bibliography, properly cited quotations, and small phrase matches (5-7 words) are valid standard exclusions. Arbitrarily excluding high-similarity paragraphs without justification is a severe integrity violation.

blocks.explain: Do not let anyone convince you to buy a thesis or copy from another university's library. In Pakistan, HEC can revoke your degree 5, 10, or 20 years from now. If someone reports the plagiarism later, the university syndicate will cancel your degree, and you will lose your job.

questions.q: True or False: Once a university has formally awarded a degree and issued the final transcript, the degree cannot be revoked even if plagiarism is later proven.
options: True — awarded degrees are legally final and cannot be challenged.
False — HEC policy and university statutes grant full authority to cancel and revoke degrees at any time.
questions.hint: Consider the legal mandate of university syndicates regarding academic fraud.
questions.explanation: False. There is no statute of limitations on plagiarism in Pakistan. If substantial plagiarism is established after graduation, the university syndicate has full statutory power to revoke the degree and notify the national gazette.

blocks.explain: Never use AI rewriters or spinning websites to beat Turnitin. They replace words with bizarre synonyms that make examiners laugh and fail you. Instead, use the 4-step method: read the paragraph, close your laptop, explain the idea out loud to yourself, and then type what you said into your thesis. That is true paraphrasing, and Turnitin will never flag it.

questions.q: What is the primary danger of using online 'spinning' tools or simple synonym replacement to lower a Turnitin score?
options: It makes the thesis file size too large to upload.
It produces unreadable, unnatural phrasing that examiners instantly recognize as patchwriting and academic misconduct.
It automatically changes APA 7th citations into Harvard style.
It deletes your statistical calculations in SPSS.
questions.hint: Think about how experienced examiners evaluate language coherence and academic tone.
questions.explanation: Spinning tools replace words without understanding academic context, producing nonsensical sentences. Evaluators readily recognize this as 'patchwriting', leading to committee investigations and thesis rejection.

key: Maximum overall similarity ceiling for MS and PhD theses in Pakistan is 19%.
No single source match may exceed 5%, regardless of the overall score.
Mandatory Turnitin exclusions permitted: Bibliography, Quoted material, Small matches (5-7 words), and Preliminary pages.
Plagiarism penalties include thesis rejection, suspension, expulsion, and retroactive degree revocation.
Supervisors share joint liability and face loss of HEC Approved status and inclusion on the national blacklist.
True conceptual paraphrasing and multi-source synthesis naturally reduce similarity scores to near zero.
mistakes: Assuming a 12% overall score is safe when a single source contributes 7% (violates the 5% single-source rule).
Leaving the terminal bibliography enabled in Turnitin, which inflates scores by 10-15%.
Using online article spinners, which creates absurd prose easily spotted by examiners.
Believing a degree is permanent once conferred—HEC can legally revoke degrees years later.
Failing to exclude small matches (5-7 words), which penalizes standard disciplinary terminology.
